meta.title: Estadio Quisqueya Juan Marichal | Quisqueya Juan Marichal Stadium
meta.description: Explore Estadio Quisqueya Juan Marichal in Santo Domingo, Dominican Republic. One of the most important baseball stadiums in the Dominican Republic.

hero.title: Estadio Quisqueya Juan Marichal — The Soul of Dominican Baseball
hero.subtitle: Feel the purest baseball passion in the Caribbean! The glorious home of Tigres del Licey and Leones del Escogido.

intro.title: Explore Estadio Quisqueya Juan Marichal
intro.description: In the Dominican Republic, baseball is not just a sport; it's a religion. Join tens of thousands of passionate fans, accompanied by Latin music, local Presidente beer, and cheerleader chants, to experience an adrenaline-pumping LIDOM game. This is the shared home of two legendary Dominican baseball teams: Tigres del Licey and Leones del Escogido.

visitGuide.title: Visiting Tips
items: Traffic around the stadium is extremely congested an hour before the game. It is recommended to arrive early by Uber or taxi.
It is recommended to check game schedules and ticket information in advance. Popular games require early booking.
Experience Dominican baseball culture and enthusiastic atmosphere.
Respect stadium rules and other spectators.

alsoKnownAs.title: Highlights
items: ⚾ Dual Home (Winter Exclusive): During the LIDOM season from October to January, come witness the century-old rivalry between Licey (Tigers) and Escogido (Lions). (Note: Off-season visits offer exterior sightseeing and historical tours of the surrounding area)
🍻 Authentic Food: Enjoy classic Dominican snacks and ice-cold beer in the stands.
🌟 Hall of Fame Tribute: Pay respects to the statue and honors of the great pitcher Juan Marichal.
🏟️ Top Atmosphere: Feel the passionate cheers of approximately 14,465 spectators.

route.title: Tour & Practical Guide
route.overview: The perfect route to explore Estadio Quisqueya Juan Marichal:
steps: 🎫 Ticketing Guide: It is recommended to purchase regular season or playoff tickets through the official website or on-site ticket booths. Please make sure to grab tickets in advance for popular games.
🚗 Traffic & Parking: Traffic around the stadium is extremely congested an hour before the game. It is recommended to arrive early by Uber or taxi.
🏟️ Seating Guide: Premium seats (Palcos) offer the best view; the outfield stands (Bleachers) have the most passionate atmosphere, but please pay attention to safety.
🌟 Nearby Recommendations: The Colonial Zone (Zona Colonial) of Santo Domingo is about a 15-minute drive away. It is recommended to visit the old town before the game.
supplements: It is recommended to check the game schedule in advance and experience the atmosphere of live games.
Pay attention to the stadium's opening hours and arrange your itinerary reasonably.
Please take care of the stadium facilities and abide by the game-watching rules.

sections.title: Historical Significance
sections.content: Estadio Quisqueya Juan Marichal is an important sports and cultural landmark in the Dominican Republic, carrying rich baseball traditions and history, and is an important venue for the Dominican Professional Baseball League (LIDOM).

sections.title: Sports Facilities
sections.content: It features complete sports facilities and excellent game-watching environment, making it an excellent place to experience Dominican baseball culture.

sections.title: Visiting Experience
sections.content: Feeling the Dominican baseball enthusiasm and cultural atmosphere at Estadio Quisqueya Juan Marichal is an unforgettable sports and cultural experience.

officialManagement.title: About Estadio Quisqueya Juan Marichal
officialManagement.text: Estadio Quisqueya Juan Marichal is a famous baseball stadium in Santo Domingo, featuring rich baseball history and excellent sports facilities. It is an important sports and cultural landmark loved by local residents and tourists.

historyTimeline.title: Historical Timeline

items.title: Official Opening
items.description: The stadium was officially inaugurated, built under the direction of dictator Trujillo (originally named Estadio Trujillo).

items.title: First LIDOM Match
items.description: Hosted the first Dominican Professional Baseball League (LIDOM) match, opening a new era for Dominican baseball.

items.title: Tribute to Juan Marichal
items.description: To honor the great pitcher Juan Marichal, the first Dominican inducted into the National Baseball Hall of Fame, the stadium was officially renamed Estadio Quisqueya Juan Marichal.

items.title: Caribbean Series
items.description: Has hosted the Caribbean Series (Serie del Caribe) multiple times, becoming one of the highest temples of Latin American baseball.

historyTimeline.guideContent: When visiting, you can start by entering the stadium area from the main entrance on Avenida Tiradentes; then walk around the stadium to enjoy the architecture and exterior landscapes; if you have enough time, you can learn about the stadium's baseball history and cultural value. Finally, explore the urban scenery around the stadium and feel the charm of the Dominican capital.
